title: ระบบฐานข้อมูลคณะสงฆ์และการศึกษา

models.name: User
models.definition:
model User {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  subjectRef      String          @unique @db.VarChar(128) // IdP subject; never an email address
  active          Boolean         @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  grants          UserGrant[]
  person          Person?
  auditEvents     AuditEvent[]    @relation("AuditActor")
  approvals       ApprovalDecision[] @relation("ApprovalActor")
  imports         ImportJob[]     @relation("ImportRequestedBy")
}

models.name: Role
models.definition:
model Role {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code            RoleCode        @unique
  displayName     String          @db.VarChar(160)
  grants          UserGrant[]
  permissions     RolePermission[]
}

models.name: Permission
RolePermission
models.definition:
model RolePermission {
  roleId          String          @db.Uuid
  permissionId    String          @db.Uuid
  role            Role            @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  permission      Permission      @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@id([roleId, permissionId])
}

models.name: UserGrant
models.definition:
model UserGrant {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId          String          @db.Uuid
  roleId          String          @db.Uuid
  scopeId         String          @db.Uuid
  validFrom       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  validUntil      DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  grantedByUserId String?         @db.Uuid
  revokedAt       DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  revokeReason    String?         @db.Text
  user            User            @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  role            Role            @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  scope           Scope           @relation(fields: [scopeId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@index([userId, validUntil, revokedAt])
  @@index([scopeId, roleId])
}

models.name: Scope
models.definition:
model Scope {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  type            ScopeType
  code            String          @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  pathKey         String          @unique @db.VarChar(600) // e.g. /GEO/SYN-01; prefix match is server-side policy input
  parentId        String?         @db.Uuid
  organisationId  String?         @unique @db.Uuid
  parent          Scope?          @relation("ScopeHierarchy", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  children        Scope[]         @relation("ScopeHierarchy")
  organisation    Organisation?   @relation(fields: [organisationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  grants          UserGrant[]
  @@index([parentId])
  @@index([type, pathKey])
}

models.name: Person
models.definition:
model Person {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  userId          String?         @unique @db.Uuid
  publicLabel     String          @db.VarChar(240) // synthetic/non-sensitive projection only
  isSynthetic     Boolean         @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  user            User?           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  privateProfiles PersonPrivate[]
  contacts        PersonContact[]
  assignments     PositionAssignment[]
  candidates      Candidate[]
  @@index([isSynthetic])
}

models.name: PersonPrivate
models.definition:
model PersonPrivate {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  personId        String          @db.Uuid
  versionNo       Int
  legalNameCiphertext String?     @db.Text
  birthDate       DateTime?       @db.Date
  identifierHash  String?         @db.VarChar(128) // one-way HMAC/hash, no raw identifier
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  person          Person          @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([personId, versionNo])
  @@index([identifierHash])
  @@index([personId, createdAt(sort: Desc)])
}

models.name: PersonContact
models.definition:
model PersonContact {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  personId        String          @db.Uuid
  channel         String          @db.VarChar(32)
  valueCiphertext String          @db.Text
  verifiedAt      DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  retiredAt       DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  person          Person          @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@index([personId, channel, retiredAt])
}

models.name: Organisation
models.definition:
model Organisation {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code            String          @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  type            OrganisationType
  displayName     String          @db.VarChar(240)
  parentId        String?         @db.Uuid
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  parent          Organisation?   @relation("OrganisationHierarchy", fields: [parentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  children        Organisation[]  @relation("OrganisationHierarchy")
  scope           Scope?
  statusEvents    OrganisationStatusEvent[]
  positions       Position[]
  educationUnits  EducationUnit[]
  examSites       ExamSite[]
  @@index([parentId, type])
}

models.name: OrganisationStatusEvent
models.definition:
model OrganisationStatusEvent {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  organisationId  String          @db.Uuid
  state           LifecycleState
  effectiveAt     DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  reason          String?         @db.Text
  recordedByUserId String?        @db.Uuid
  recordedAt      DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  organisation    Organisation    @relation(fields: [organisationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([organisationId, effectiveAt, id])
  @@index([organisationId, effectiveAt(sort: Desc)])
}

models.name: Position
models.definition:
model Position {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  organisationId  String          @db.Uuid
  code            String          @db.VarChar(120)
  title           String          @db.VarChar(240)
  positionClass   String          @db.VarChar(80)
  activeFrom      DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  retiredAt       DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  organisation    Organisation    @relation(fields: [organisationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  assignments     PositionAssignment[]
  @@unique([organisationId, code])
  @@index([organisationId, retiredAt])
}

models.name: PositionAssignment
models.definition:
model PositionAssignment {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  positionId      String          @db.Uuid
  personId        String          @db.Uuid
  validFrom       DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  validUntil      DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  appointmentRef  String?         @db.VarChar(180)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  position        Position        @relation(fields: [positionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  person          Person          @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  events          PositionAssignmentEvent[]
  @@index([positionId, validUntil])
  @@index([personId, validUntil])
}

models.name: PositionAssignmentEvent
models.definition:
model PositionAssignmentEvent {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  assignmentId    String          @db.Uuid
  state           PositionState
  effectiveAt     DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  reason          String?         @db.Text
  approvalId      String?         @db.Uuid
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  assignment      PositionAssignment @relation(fields: [assignmentId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  approval        ApprovalDecision? @relation(fields: [approvalId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([assignmentId, effectiveAt, id])
  @@index([assignmentId, effectiveAt(sort: Desc)])
}

models.name: EducationUnit
models.definition:
model EducationUnit {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  organisationId  String          @db.Uuid
  code            String          @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  displayName     String          @db.VarChar(240)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  organisation    Organisation    @relation(fields: [organisationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  candidates      Candidate[]
  @@index([organisationId])
}

models.name: LegalSource
models.definition:
model LegalSource {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  sourceTitle     String          @db.VarChar(500)
  sourceSection   String?         @db.VarChar(500)
  effectiveFrom   DateTime?       @db.Date
  effectiveUntil  DateTime?       @db.Date
  evidenceState   LegalEvidenceState @default(TO_VERIFY)
  evidenceUri     String?         @db.Text
  reviewerRole    String?         @db.VarChar(160)
  reviewedAt      DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  requirements    LegalRequirement[]
  @@index([evidenceState, effectiveFrom])
}

models.name: LegalRequirement
models.definition:
model LegalRequirement {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  legalSourceId   String          @db.Uuid
  domain          String          @db.VarChar(120)
  ruleKey         String          @unique @db.VarChar(160)
  interpretation  String          @db.Text
  evidenceState   LegalEvidenceState @default(TO_VERIFY)
  source          LegalSource     @relation(fields: [legalSourceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  approvals       ApprovalDecision[]
  @@index([legalSourceId, evidenceState])
}

models.name: ApprovalDecision
models.definition:
model ApprovalDecision {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  requirementId   String?         @db.Uuid
  requestedByUserId String?       @db.Uuid
  decidedByUserId String?         @db.Uuid
  state           ApprovalState   @default(REQUESTED)
  subjectType     String          @db.VarChar(120)
  subjectId       String          @db.Uuid
  decisionReason  String?         @db.Text
  requestedAt     DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  decidedAt       DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  requirement     LegalRequirement? @relation(fields: [requirementId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  decider         User?           @relation("ApprovalActor", fields: [decidedByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  assignmentEvents PositionAssignmentEvent[]
  applicationEvents ApplicationStatusEvent[]
  @@index([subjectType, subjectId, state])
}

models.name: ExamCycle
models.definition:
model ExamCycle {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  code            String          @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  label           String          @db.VarChar(240)
  opensAt         DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  closesAt        DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  sessions        ExamSession[]
  @@index([opensAt, closesAt])
}

models.name: ExamSession
models.definition:
model ExamSession {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  examCycleId     String          @db.Uuid
  code            String          @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  label           String          @db.VarChar(240)
  startsAt        DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  endsAt          DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  cycle           ExamCycle       @relation(fields: [examCycleId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  sites           ExamSite[]
  applications    Application[]
  @@index([examCycleId, startsAt])
}

models.name: ExamSite
models.definition:
model ExamSite {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  examSessionId   String          @db.Uuid
  organisationId  String          @db.Uuid
  code            String          @db.VarChar(120)
  label           String          @db.VarChar(240)
  capacity        Int
  session         ExamSession     @relation(fields: [examSessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  organisation    Organisation    @relation(fields: [organisationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  applications    Application[]
  @@unique([examSessionId, code])
  @@index([organisationId, examSessionId])
}

models.name: Candidate
models.definition:
model Candidate {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  personId        String          @db.Uuid
  educationUnitId String?         @db.Uuid
  candidateNo     String          @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  person          Person          @relation(fields: [personId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  educationUnit   EducationUnit?  @relation(fields: [educationUnitId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  applications    Application[]
  @@index([personId])
  @@index([educationUnitId])
}

models.name: Application
models.definition:
model Application {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  candidateId     String          @db.Uuid
  examSessionId   String          @db.Uuid
  examSiteId      String?         @db.Uuid
  applicationNo   String          @unique @db.VarChar(120)
  submittedAt     DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  candidate       Candidate       @relation(fields: [candidateId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  session         ExamSession     @relation(fields: [examSessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  examSite        ExamSite?       @relation(fields: [examSiteId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  statusEvents    ApplicationStatusEvent[]
  documents       ApplicationDocument[]
  results         ExamResult[]
  @@unique([candidateId, examSessionId])
  @@index([examSessionId, examSiteId])
}

models.name: ApplicationStatusEvent
models.definition:
model ApplicationStatusEvent {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  applicationId   String          @db.Uuid
  state           ApplicationState
  effectiveAt     DateTime        @db.Timestamptz(6)
  reason          String?         @db.Text
  approvalId      String?         @db.Uuid
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  application     Application     @relation(fields: [applicationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  approval        ApprovalDecision? @relation(fields: [approvalId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([applicationId, effectiveAt, id])
  @@index([applicationId, effectiveAt(sort: Desc)])
}

models.name: ExamResult
models.definition:
model ExamResult {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  applicationId   String          @db.Uuid
  subjectCode     String          @db.VarChar(120)
  score           Decimal?        @db.Decimal(7, 2)
  maximumScore    Decimal         @db.Decimal(7, 2)
  state           ExamResultState @default(PENDING)
  announcedAt     DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  application     Application     @relation(fields: [applicationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([applicationId, subjectCode])
  @@index([state, announcedAt])
}

models.name: StoredObject
models.definition:
model StoredObject {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  storageKey      String          @unique @db.VarChar(900)
  checksumSha256  String          @db.VarChar(128)
  contentType     String          @db.VarChar(160)
  byteSize        BigInt
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  documentVersions DocumentVersion[]
  importJobs      ImportJob[]
}

models.name: DocumentRecord
models.definition:
model DocumentRecord {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  subjectType     String          @db.VarChar(120)
  subjectId       String          @db.Uuid
  documentType    String          @db.VarChar(120)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  versions        DocumentVersion[]
  applicationLinks ApplicationDocument[]
  @@index([subjectType, subjectId])
}

models.name: DocumentVersion
models.definition:
model DocumentVersion {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  documentRecordId String         @db.Uuid
  storedObjectId  String          @db.Uuid
  versionNo       Int
  state           DocumentState   @default(PENDING)
  reason          String?         @db.Text
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  record          DocumentRecord  @relation(fields: [documentRecordId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  object          StoredObject    @relation(fields: [storedObjectId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([documentRecordId, versionNo])
  @@index([storedObjectId])
}

models.name: ApplicationDocument
models.definition:
model ApplicationDocument {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  applicationId   String          @db.Uuid
  documentRecordId String         @db.Uuid
  documentKind    String          @db.VarChar(120)
  linkedAt        DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  application     Application     @relation(fields: [applicationId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  record          DocumentRecord  @relation(fields: [documentRecordId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([applicationId, documentKind, documentRecordId])
  @@index([documentRecordId])
}

models.name: ImportJob
models.definition:
model ImportJob {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  requestedByUserId String?       @db.Uuid
  sourceObjectId  String          @db.Uuid
  entityType      String          @db.VarChar(120)
  state           ImportState     @default(UPLOADED)
  idempotencyKey  String          @unique @db.VarChar(160)
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  startedAt       DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  completedAt     DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  requestedBy     User?           @relation("ImportRequestedBy", fields: [requestedByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  sourceObject    StoredObject    @relation(fields: [sourceObjectId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  rows            ImportRow[]
  @@index([state, createdAt])
}

models.name: ImportRow
models.definition:
model ImportRow {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  importJobId     String          @db.Uuid
  rowNo           Int
  state           ImportState     @default(UPLOADED)
  errorCode       String?         @db.VarChar(120)
  errorDetail     String?         @db.Text
  sourceSnapshot  Json
  createdAt       DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  job             ImportJob       @relation(fields: [importJobId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@unique([importJobId, rowNo])
  @@index([importJobId, state])
}

models.name: AuditEvent
models.definition:
model AuditEvent {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  actorUserId     String?         @db.Uuid
  action          String          @db.VarChar(160)
  outcome         EventOutcome
  entityType      String          @db.VarChar(120)
  entityId        String          @db.Uuid
  requestId       String          @db.VarChar(160)
  scopePath       String?         @db.VarChar(600)
  occurredAt      DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  metadata        Json?
  actor           User?           @relation("AuditActor", fields: [actorUserId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  @@index([entityType, entityId, occurredAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@index([actorUserId, occurredAt(sort: Desc)])
  @@index([requestId])
}

models.name: OutboxEvent
models.definition:
model OutboxEvent {
  id              String          @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  aggregateType   String          @db.VarChar(120)
  aggregateId     String          @db.Uuid
  eventType       String          @db.VarChar(160)
  payload         Json
  occurredAt      DateTime        @default(now()) @db.Timestamptz(6)
  publishedAt     DateTime?       @db.Timestamptz(6)
  attempts        Int             @default(0)
  idempotencyKey  String          @unique @db.VarChar(160)
  @@index([publishedAt, occurredAt])
  @@index([aggregateType, aggregateId, occurredAt])
}
